faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Rewari (AIIMS Rewari) for filling up Junior Resident positions in Haryana.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 25 vacancies available for the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) post across various reservation categories like UR, OBC, SC, ST, and EWS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled hard copy of the application form along with required enclosures is 28-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree including the completion of a mandatory internship and must be registered with the Central or State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to AIIMS Rewari Junior Resident?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for general category candidates is 33 years, with admissible age relaxations provided for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed at Pay Level 10, receiving a basic monthly salary of Rs. 56100/- along with other applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Rewari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is completely offline. Candidates must download the form, fill it out, and send the physical copy by post or hand.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the recruitment process?
faq.answer: Yes, General and OBC candidates must pay Rs. 1500/-, SC/ST/EWS candidates pay Rs. 1000/-, while PwBD candidates are exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Junior Residents at AIIMS Rewari?
faq.answer: The selection process includes scrutiny of applications, a qualifying written test (if applicable), a 100-mark interview, document verification, and a medical examination.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I send the completed offline application form?
faq.answer: You must send the application form to the O/o Executive Director, AYUSH Block, Ground Floor, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Majra, Rewari, Haryana, 123102.
